Commentary.Commentary: The momentum shifted when the record 84-run partnership between Jimmy Neesham and Matt Henry lower down the order took New Zealand near the 300-run mark. Neesham was impressive with the bat as he hit a superb fifty while Henry chipped in with a handy 39. Will this be enough for the Kiwis? Don't forget India are good at chasing and dew could come into play as well. Join us back in a bit for the run chase!

Pretty good total by New Zealand, that! They got off to a good start, thanks to Guptill but his innings was cut short by Yadav. The other opener Latham made another fifty and they were 153/2 at one stage but suddenly lost the momentum and were reduced to 199/8. Kedar Jadhav picked up three wickets while Amit Mishra chipped in with two scalps. Umesh Yadav picked up three wickets but he was taken for runs towards the end.

OUT! The slower one does the trick. Bumrah slyly takes the pace off it and bowls a cutter on off, Boult is too early into the shot and swings his bat hard. He misses and the off pole is taken for the walk. NEW ZEALAND ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 285!
Another full ball on the stumps, almost a yorker, it's drilled down to long on for one run.
Length ball outside off, Boult gets a bottom edge behind to the keeper as he tries to hit it on the off side. The batsmen sneak in a quick single as the ball goes behind towards the keeper.
Bumrah arrows it in full and on middle and leg, it's worked to mid-wicket for no run.
TRENT BOULT is the last man in.

OUT! A bit of relief for the Indians as Jimmy Neesham walks back but he's played a fantastic knock here. Full toss on off from around the wicket, Neesham looks to go big down the ground but skies it over covers. Jadhav is the man there, he runs a bit behind from extra cover, settles himself under the ball and takes a very good catch. Partnership of 84 runs comes to an end, and it came in just 11.1 overs.
Full and fired in on middle and leg, it's flicked through to deep mid-wicket for a single. Henry wanted the second but was sent back by Jimmy.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, too far out and there's a lot of room for Matt Henry to free his arms. He lofts it over covers and picks up another boundary. He's on a rampage here.
FOUR! Henry is going for it now. He flicks this full ball through the mid-wicket region and picks up a boundary.
SIX! He's got that off the meat of the bat! Back of a length delivery around off, Henry stays back and pulls it hard over mid-wicket. Clears the fence comfortably and gets a biggie to his name.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Henry gives it the full swing and ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads. Dot ball.
Henry this time punches it towards mid off and takes on Kohli. He has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A run is completed.

On a good length and outside off, Matt Henry punches it towards Rahane at covers. Neesham set off for the run but then was sent back. A throw is fired in at the bowler's end but no direct hit was made.
Slower bouncer on this occasion, it's pulled away on the on side for two good runs.
Bumrah brings out the yorker and fires it in accurately, it's dug out well on the on side for a single.
FOUR! HE'S SCYTHED THAT AWAY! Fuller and outside off, Neesham carves it over backward point. There's nobody out in the deep and hence, the ball will roll away to the boundary line.

Full and outside off, Matt drives it hard to the covers. Rahane is the man there and he puts it a good dive to stop the ball. Just can't keep the batsmen from taking a single. Neesham is back on strike now.
Maiden ODI fifty for Jimmy Neesham!

FOUR! Length ball outside off, Neesham swings his bat hard at this and gets a big top edge over the vacant slip cordon. It races away to the third man fence and with that, Neesham brings up his half century.
Back of a length outside off, blocked.
Full toss outside off, Jimmy Neesham lofts it down towards long off and runs hard from the word go. Comes back for the second as Henry puts in a last ditch dive at the bowler's end. Two completed.

FOUR! That's a brilliant shot! From around the wicket, Umesh fires it in full and gets it to angle in on middle and off, it's slogged hard over mid-wicket and perfectly into the gap. Sends it all the way to the boundary. Neesham is playing an impressive knock here for his team.
50-run stand between Neesham and Henry!
Length ball shaping in on the hips, it's glance down to fine leg for one.
Pitched on a length and outside off, played to point for one.
YADAV returns.
Full and outside off, it's driven towards sweeper cover for a run to end the over.
Bumrah brings out the short one yet again, it's pulled down towards fine leg for one run.
Short one from Bumrah once more, it's angling in sharply as Henry awkwardly tries to fend it away. Has a right chuckle at it as he sees the funny side of it.
Length ball angled across the southpaw, it's tapped towards backward point for a quick single.
Slower one from Bumrah, on a length and outside off, it's run down to third man with a open face for a run.
Starts off with a bouncer on middle and off, Henry looks to ramp it over the keeper's head but fails to do so.
Bumrah is back!
Yorker from Axar Patel to end the over with. Fired it in accurately and it's kept out equally well by the left-hander.
Flat and short outside off, Neesham cuts it wide of sweeper cover once more. Pandey out in the deep does well to dive and keep it in. Two runs taken.
Patel bowls this slower through the air and it's going away from Jimmy, he has plenty of time to go back and cut it wide of sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Fuller and flat on middle and off, Jimmy Neesham kneels down to this one and sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Another flat one on the pads, Jimmy works this square on the leg side for two runs.
Full and flat on middle and leg, hits Neesham on the pads as he tries to work it to the leg side.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, swept through backward square leg for a single to end the over.

FOUR! Supreme placement! Loopy and full on the stumps, Neesham brings the wrists into play and flicks it ever so well through mid-wicket. Beats the two fielders out in the deep as the gap is bisected to perfection. Brilliant shot. Important runs these for the Kiwis.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Fullish outside off, it's pushed away towards point off the front foot for a single.
Nicely played in the gap. Nicely tossed up on the stumps, it's wristed nicely through the mid-wicket region for a brace.
Loopy around off, Neesham reverse sweeps it down towards short third man. It's straight to the fielder so no run can be taken.
Slower through the air and on the shorter side once more, it's cut away by Henry to covers.
Shorter one from Patel once more, it's punched down to long on for one.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated nicely outside off, Henry goes for the drive but gets an edge which goes past Dhoni down towards third man. Two run are taken.
From around the wicket, some nice drift on that, turning away a bit as well, beats the outside edge of Henry's bat.

Dropped! Touch chance though. Short and flat outside off, Henry back away to cut it away but the ball keeps a little low. Goes off the bottom half and then hits Dhoni's pad. Technically a dropped chance but was quite harsh.
Axar Patel is back.

A hint of reverse swing there. It's tailing in on the pads, goes off it as Henry looks to flick it away. Strange once more, a run is signalled by the umpire. Maybe there was some bat on it. A run taken.
Wide! Banged in short by Umesh Yadav, wide signalled. Guess it was too short.
Fullish in length and aimed at the base of off stump, Matt Henry punches it down towards mid off. No run taken.
Full and fired in on middle and leg, tailing in, it's dug out towards mid-wicket. Dot ball.
On the shorter side once more, kept out off the back foot.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery on off, Henry backs away and crashes the punch through the cover region to pick up a boundary. Vital runs these for New Zealand.
Wide! A short ball going down the leg side, wide signalled as Henry ducks to evade it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, played back in the direction of the bowler.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Fired one across the left-hander, Neesham goes for the sweep but fails to make any connection.
Looped up around off, the googly again, Neesham gets an edge towards gully as he tries to defend it.
Googly from Amir Mishra, don't think Henry read it early but still managed to get his bat down in time and punch it down to long on for a single.
Flat and going down leg, goes off the pads to the on side as he tries to flick and a the batsmen cross over. But it seems a run is signalled. Strange.
Flatter one on the stumps, kept out solidly.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders will now be allowed outside the circle.
Landed outside off, Henry punches it off his back foot to end the over.
FOUR! UPPISH! Shortish outside off, Henry cuts it through point and the ball goes through the gap. Henry gets a boundary.
Short ball on off, Henry lets it go through.
Fullish outside off, Neesham drives it through mid off for a run.
Around off, Henry flicks it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Henry punches it to the off side.
Shortish outside off again, Henry punches it through covers for a single.
Shortish outside off, Henry cuts it to point.
Fuller length ball on off, Henry drives it towards mid off.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Landed outside off, Neesham pushes it towards point.
FOUR! Great shot! Outside off, Neesham hits it past the bowler. The ball goes past the fence quickly and 200 up for New Zealand!
Landed around off, Henry works it to the leg side.
MATT HENRY walks in next.

OUT! Southee drags it on! Short of a length ball outside off, Southee goes for the pull but the ball goes off the inside edge and onto his stumps. Yadav picks up his second wicket and New Zealand lose their eighth wicket.
Length ball outside off, Southee pushes it to point.
Around off, Southee tries to play but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Landed outside off, Neesham plays it through point for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Neesham drives it through covers for a couple.
Umesh Yadav is back.
Yorker on off, Southee digs it out nicely.
Shortish on off, Southee defends it off his back foot.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Yorker on off, Southee digs it out. The ball goes to mid-wicket where Pandey scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but replays confirm he's safe.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Landed outside off, Southee plays it through point for a single.
Gives this plenty of air and attacks the stumps, it's worked to mid-wicket.
Drags the length back on this and keeps it around off, it's kept out solidly off the back foot.
Floats it up around the off stump, blocked off the front foot.
Loopy full toss on off, it's worked to the on side. Kedar Jadhav at short leg is hit on the body and the batsmen take a single as the ball goes off him towards mid-wicket.
Looped up on off, it's eased down to long off for a single.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
MISHRA is back into the attack.
Landed outside off, Southee fails to put his bat on the ball.
FOUR! Edged! Outside off, Southee tries to push but gets a thick outside edge to third man for another boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length ball outside off, Southee punches it through point for a boundary. What a way to get off the mark.
Fullish outside off, driven through covers for a couple.
TIM SOUTHEE is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Fuller length ball around off, Santner tries to flick but gets a leading edge. The ball goes towards backward point where Kohli takes the catch. Bumrah gets his first wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
DRINKS BREAK!
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Shortish outside off, Santner cuts it through point and takes a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a couple.
Outside off, turning away, Santner is beaten completely.
Landed outside off, punched straight to short cover.
Fullish outside off, Santner drives it towards mid off.
Landed around off, Jimmy blocks it out off his front foot.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fuller length ball around off, Neesham drives it down the ground. The ball races away to the fence in a flash.
Landed outside off, Santner tries to push but gets an outside edge to third man. Single taken.
BEATEN! Good length ball on off, angling away, Santner tries to push but misses it completely.
Yorker on off, Santner digs it out watchfully.
Fuller length ball outside off, Santner drives it to mid off.
Bumrah is back on.
Landed outside off, punched through covers for a single.
MITCHELL SANTNER is the next man in.

OUT! Straight to the fielder! Yet another wicket for Kedar Jadhav! Fullish outside off, Latham chips it straight to Pandya at covers. Easy catch there and the opener departs. New Zealand slip further, six down for just 169. Third wicket for Jadhav!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Landed outside off, Neesham punches it away off his back foot for a single.
Around off, Neesham defends it from within his crease.
Outside off, turns away, Neesham tries to push but gets beaten.
Worked away to the leg side by Neesham. Single taken.
Shortish on middle and leg, Latham pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish on off, Latham punches it away off his back foot for a couple.
Landed outside off, Neesham plays it through point for a single.
JIMMY NEESHAM walks in next.

OUT! STUMPED! Landed around off, Ronchi lunges forward to drive but gets beaten as the ball turns away. Dhoni quickly whips off the bails in a flash as Ronchi tries to make it back. Third umpire referred and replays confirm Dhoni is pretty quick. Another wicket for Mishra!
There is an appeal for a stumping. Dhoni looks confident.
Landed around off, Ronchi gets onto his front foot and defends.
Some rare flight from Kedar Jadhav, it's driven to covers for one run.
Flatter delivery outside off from over the wicket, blocked off the back foot.
LUKE RONCHI is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Anderson's brief stay has come to an end. A high full toss from Kedar Jadhav, from around the wicket, Anderson looks to take the aerial route and clear mid off. Is in no control of that and ends up lobbing it towards Rahane there who runs a few paces behind and takes it. Another wicket down for New Zealand.
FOUR! That's a good shot. Anderson gets to the pitch of the delivery and hammers it over the bowler's head. He's hit that hard enough and it leaves no chance for any fielder to stop it.
Flatter and shorter in length on the stumps, it's punched down to long on for a single.
From around the wicket, it's full outside off, played to mid off for a quick single.
Kedar Jadhav back on.
Latham has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated well just outside the off stump, Anderson drives it towards mid off and takes a single. Is off the mark with that.
Looped up on middle and off, worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
COREY ANDERSON is the next batsman in.

OUT! MISHRA STRIKES! And the wicket has come at a crucial time as well. It's tossed up around off, turns away nicely as Ross Taylor looks to work this towards mid on. He's off balance as well as he plays this and this allows Dhoni to whip the bails off. He's lightning as it is and that's easy for him. Partnership of 73 runs has been broken.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. They pick up a single.

Not out! Seemed in to the naked eye as well. Latham makes good use of his feet again and works it to deep square leg. The batsmen run hard and come back for the second. Rahane is the man out in the deep and he fires in a throw at the bowler's end. Gets a direct hit as Taylor slides his bat in. The decision goes upstairs and replays show that he was well in. Two runs completed.
A run out appeal against Ross Taylor is referred upstairs.
AMIT MISHRA is back on.
SIX! He's cleared the fence nicely there. Full around off, it's flat as Ross Taylor gets down to this one. Mistimes his slog sweep but it's still enough to get across the fence for a maximum.
This time Taylor skips down the track but he blocks it.
Tom Latham once again gets to the pitch of the delivery and eases it down to long on for a single.
Full on off stump, it's driven towards long off for a single.
Shorter and flatter outside off, cut away to the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Axar Patel has taken the ball again. Dhoni seems to be having a good, long talk with him. Maybe about tactics..?
Good length delivery outside off, played to point for nothing to end the over.
Length ball on middle and leg, it's turned towards backward square leg for one run.
Comes over the wicket to Ross Taylor, lands it on a length and outside off, it's run down to third man for a couple of runs. Placed it quite square and hence was able to come back for the second.
Wide! It's banged in short but it's too short, wide called by the umpire.
On a good length and angling in on off, Latham pushes it back down to mid on for a brisk single.
Fuller length delivery pitched outside off, it's driven to mid off.
Comes from around the wicket and angles in a length ball from around off, it's pushed to covers off the back foot.
This full ball is pushed to the cover region for no run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Around off, worked to mid-wicket with a closed face.
FOUR! Full and flat outside off, width on offer and Taylor accepts. Smashes it through the covers and beats the man at sweeper cover to pick up a boundary.
Full outside off, driven back down to mid off.
6th ODI fifty for Tom Latham!
Full on the stumps, Tom Latham uses his feet well to get to the pitch and drives it down to long on. Brings up his fifty with that as well. Superb knock.
Banged in short by Hardik Pandya, it's ducked and evaded well by Ross Taylor.
Full outside off, driven to covers for nothing.
On a good length and outside off, guided down to third man for one.
Short of a length delivery on the body, it goes off the top edge as Taylor looks to pull. Lobs over towards mid-wicket and a single is taken.
Back of a length and angling in from outside off, played off the back foot on the off side.
50-run stand between Latham and Taylor!
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Taylor latches on to this in a flash. He rocks back and cuts it through point to send it all the way. Great shot.
HARDIK PANDYA is back on.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Another flat ball which is punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Taylor steps out to this one and plays it back in the direction of the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter on the pads, it's nudged through backward square leg for a couple of good runs.
Flatter one on off stump, Ross Taylor is a little cramped for room and he goes back to cut it. He ends up chopping it towards backward point.
Full on the stumps, it's played back to the bowler for nothing.
Flighted up outside off, Mishra gives it plenty of air, it's pushed to the covers for one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floats this one up well outside off, Taylor drives it through the cover region and gets two runs to his name.
Ripper of a delivery! Tossed up leg breaker around off, Ross Taylor comes forward to block but the ball turns sharply and beats the outside edge.

Loopy and fullish in length around off, Tom gets to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it down towards mid off. Rahane is the man there and he puts in a superb dive to stop the ball from going past him. Keeps the batsmen down to just one.
Swept away on the on side by the left-hander for a single to end the over.
Bowled slower through the air, Ross Taylor gets to the pitch and eases it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Plays this late and connects it well too. Flatter ball outside off, Taylor nails the late cut to perfection and gets it across the third man fence amazingly well. Brilliant.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Fired in full and around off, Latham is rapped on the pads as he tries to sweep it away. Loud appeal for an lbw but the umpire says not out. Impact was outside the line of off stump it seems.
Turning in to Tom Latham, it's glanced straight to the fielder at short fine leg.
Latham plays with the spin and works it to mid-wicket for one.
Short and flat outside off, punched off the back foot to short cover.

FOUR! Loopy leg-spinner just around the off stump, Tom Latham makes good use of his feet, gets to the pich of the delivery and lofts it straight back over the bowler's head. Umesh Yadav comes running in a little lazily from long on and hence, sees the ball goes across the fence. Lovely shot.
Loopy and full on off stump, drifting in, it's pushed through the cover region for an easy single.
Looped up on the stumps, Tom Latham gets low to this one and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Latham skips down the track and ends up getting it off the pads to the on side as he looks to flick it away.
Flicked away to deep square leg for a couple to end the over.
On the pads, Latham sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Full on off, driven to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Taylor comes forward and tries to cut. The ball goes off the bottom edge and almost rolls back to the stumps but he does well to stop it.
Shortish outside off, Taylor cuts it towards backward point where Kohli stops the ball.
Around off, Taylor flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full on middle and leg, driven to long on for a single to end the over.
On middle and leg, flicked away through mid-wicket for a single. 100 UP FOR NEW ZEALAND!
Full on off, driven through mid on for a single.
Shortish outside off, Taylor cuts it to point.
Landed outside off, Taylor pushes it to covers.
Around off, Latham comes down the track and helps it to long on for a single.
Landed outside off, Taylor comes down the track and chips it back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Taylor blocks it out watchfully.
On the pads, swept away to deep square leg for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Fullish ball on off, Latham tucks it to the on side.
On middle and leg, worked away to short fine leg.
On middle and leg, Ross defends it with soft hands.
Fullish around off, Taylor drives it to mid on.
FOUR! Poor ball! Short ball on middle and leg, Taylor goes onto his back foot and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Outside off, Taylor blocks it out solidly.
Landed around off, Taylor gets onto his front foot and defends.
On middle and leg, punched to wide long on for a single.
DRINKS BREAK!
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Outside off, Taylor uses his feet and drills it to long off for a single.
Landed outside off, Taylor covers the line and defends yet again.
Landed around off, Ross gets onto his front foot and defends.
Shortish outside off, Taylor cuts it towards backward point where Kohli does well to stop the ball.
On middle and leg, Latham tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish on middle and leg, Latham works it to deep mid-wicket for a single to end the over.
On the pads, Latham works it to long leg for a couple.
On middle and leg, Latham works it to the leg side.
Around off, Taylor strides forward and tucks it through square leg for a single.
On the pads, Taylor comes down the track and pads it away.
Landed outside off, Taylor lunges forward and defends it into the ground.
AMIT MISHRA comes on to bowl.
Tossed up outside off, Taylor comes forward and drills it to long off for a single.
Amit Mishra is warming up...
Landed on off, Taylor covers the line and defends.
Flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, Taylor tries to play it across but gets a leading edge towards cover-point.
Landed outside off, Taylor pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Latham drives it through mid on for a single.
AXAR PATEL comes on to bowl now.
ROSS TAYLOR walks in next.

OUT! LBW! Kedar Jadhav gets the big fish! Tossed up ball on middle and off, goes on straight with the angle, Williamson tries to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a big appeal for a leg before and the umpire raises his finger. It looked plumb. Another wicket for Jadhav in this series, he's having a golden touch with the ball. Scott Styris in the commentary box hides his face.
Landed just outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
FOUR! On the pads, Latham sweeps it to the square leg region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence. Latham is looking good yet again.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Latham tries to go after it but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Outside off, Latham pushes it towards point.
Landed outside off, goes straight on, Latham punches it back to the bowler.
Fullish on middle and leg, Williamson flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, Latham defends it with soft hands.
On the pads, Latham tucks it to long leg for a couple.
Short and wide outside off, slapped through cover-point for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Williamson stays back in his crease and defends.
Shortish outside off, Williamson cuts it towards point.
Good length ball outside off, Williamson flicks it to mid-wicket.
On middle and off, Williamson punches it to long on for a single to end the over.

Appeal for an LBW! On middle and leg, Williamson tries to slog it over the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a big appeal but the umpire says not out. The bowler looked confident though. The ball might have missed the leg stump.
On middle and leg, Latham flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Latham still goes after it but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
On the pads, Williamson sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Landed outside off, Latham punches it through covers for a single.
Fullish outside off, Williamson drives it to long off for a single.
KEDAR JADHAV comes on to bowl.
Short of a length outside off, Latham stands tall and blocks it out on the off side.
Outside off, it's played to point for no run.

AND EDGE WHICH HASN'T CARRIED! On a good length and outside off, Williamson looks to have a push at it but gets an edge behind. Unfortunately for Dhoni, it falls just short of him as he dives low to his right to take it. It goes past him and the batsmen take a single.

FOUR! WHAT. A. SHOT. That's the Natalie Portman equivalent of a cricketing stroke. Full and outside off, Williamson just stands his ground, and with a beautiful straight bat, drives it ever so well through the covers for a boundary. Holds that position for a couple of seconds too, well worth admiring.
Fullish outside off, blocked off the front foot and into the track.
Almost nicked that. Pitched just back of a length and gets it to angle is slightly from outside off, Williamson stays back and looks to run it down to third man but it just beats the outside edge.
Does well not to goof up this time. Back of a length outside off, it's guided past a diving Ajinkya Rahane down towards third man where Amit Mishra cuts it across. A single is taken to end the over.

FOUR! That's poor from Amit Mishra. Pitched up there once more, Williamson drives this square through backward point. Amit Mishra runs it from third man and slides to stop it. But much to Williamson's delight, it goes under his hands and touches the ropes. Boundary signalled as the Kiwi pair have wry smiles on their faces.
Length delivery outside off, KW opens the face of the bat and dabs it straight to Rahane at gully.
Full and on the stumps, it's played back solidly in the direction of the bowler.
Speared in full and well outside off, Kane Williamson reaches out to this one in an attempt to drive it to the covers but ends up mistiming it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery from Umesh Yadav, it's outside off as Williamson lunges forward and blocks it on the off side in front of gully.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kane walks a bit towards the ball and middles the cut down towards third man for a single. That will be the end of the over.
Another full ball from Jasprit Bumrah, Williamson once again prods forward and makes a very watchful leave as the ball goes past him.
Fired in full and way outside off, left alone by the New Zealand captain.
Fullish and outside off, Williamson looks to dab it a bit square on the off side but ends up getting a bottom edge towards Rahane in the slips.

Back of a length delivery well outside off, Williamson rocks back and with excellent balance, punches it through the gap in the covers to pick up a couple of runs. Great footwork as he played that, too.
Starts off with a length delivery down the leg side, Tom works it down towards fine leg for a single.
JASPRIT BUMRAH into the attack.

FOUR! That's a beautiful looking shot. All about the timing, that. Full and on the stumps, Kane Williamson, with a beautiful straight bat, just pushes this back down the ground. It beats a diving Jasprit Bumrah at mid on and races away to the boundary line. Bumrah though is seen holding his shoulder as he is lying on the ground, hope he's fine.
Full and outside off, Williamson mistimes his drive to mid off as he reaches out to play at that.
KANE WILLIAMSON walks in at No.3.

OUT! GUPTILL'S GONE! Absolute peach of a delivery from Umesh Yadav. Comes charging in and gets this length ball to come in to Martin Guptill. The Kiwi opener doesn't pick it up and seems to be beaten for pace. He's caught on the pads as he looks to defend and there's a big appeal for a leg before. Umpire Oxenford has no trouble raising his finger and that's the end of a fiery yet brief stay from Marty. Got off to a good start but his woes continue.
Wide! It's banged in short but it's too short, wide called by the umpire.
Straying on the hips, it's glanced down towards fine leg for an easy single.

SIX! A big edge from the southpaw but that'll be enough. Yadav comes steaming in and pounds it in hard, Tom Latham rocks back and gets a big top edge over square leg as he looks to pull it away. Nobody out there as the ball just crosses over the rope.
Pitched slightly ahead of a length and outside off, Latham leans forward and keeps it out with a straight bat.
SIX! THAT'S GONE SAILING! Full and outside off, Martin Guptill clears his front leg and launches this hard over the covers. Clears the fence with ease and gets another maximum to his name.
BEATEN! That was a ripper of a delivery! Good length delivery outside off, Guptill prods forward and looks to defend. But the ball beats the outside edge and goes into the keeper's gloves.
Banged in short and it's angling in to the body, the big Kiwi opener mistimes his pull towards square leg and picks up a couple of runs for it. Good running.
Another length delivery angling in slightly around off, it's punched off the back foot in front of covers.

FOUR! The timing on that was superb. Length delivery aimed at the top of off stump, Martin Guptill backs away a bit and crunches it between point and cover-point to send it all the way to the fence. That was hit hard and through the gap, beautiful shot.
Length ball well outside off, Guptill stands tall and cuts it away hard. It's straight to the fielder at point, though.
Short of a length ball on off, Latham covers the line and defends.
On the pads, Latham works it down the leg side for a couple.
Good length ball around off, Latham gets onto his front foot and defends.
EDGED AGAIN! Outside off, Latham tries to guide but gets an outside edge towards wide first slip. Just short of Rahane there.
EDGED! FOUR! Landed outside off, Latham tries to push but gets a thick outside edge to third man. Just beats the wide first slip fielder and goes past the fence.
Fuller length ball on middle and off, Latham drives it back to the bowler. Yadav does well to stop the ball.
Landed outside off, Guptill drives it uppishly towards mid off. The ball falls short of the fielder yet again.
In the corridor outside off, Guptill shoulders his arms.
Good length ball on off, Latham taps it to covers for a quick single. Good running between the wickets.
Landed outside off, Guptill guides it to third man for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Guptill covers the line and defends it watchfully this time.
SIX! BANG! Good length ball on off, Guptill picks the length early and lofts it high over long on. The ball goes all the way for a biggie. That was a huge one, 97 meters.
On middle and off, Guptill tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish on off, tapped towards mid off for a single.
On middle and off, Guptill flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish around off, Guptill drives it towards mid on.
The physio is out to attend Kohli. The Indian batsman looks fine now though.
Landed outside off, Guptill pushes it to covers where Kohli tries to stop the ball slips and is hurt. His fingers were jammed on the turf.
FOUR! That's a fine shot! Landed outside off, Guptill drives it through the point region. The ball goes through the gap for a boundary.

Length delivery outside off, Guptill is late as he tries to leave it alone. The ball goes off the bottom half of the bat and to the off side and the batsmen take a single. Remember Guptill was out similarly before.
Landed outside off, Latham plays it uppishly. The ball goes towards wide third man. Single taken.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Wide again outside off but this time just inside the guideline. Latham lets it go through yet again.
WIDE! Way outside off, Latham lets it go through. The umpire signals a wide this time.
Wide outside off again, Latham doesn't flirt with that one.
Angled away outside off, fuller in length, Latham leaves it alone.
HARDIK PANDYA to bowl from the other end.

EDGED! Length ball on off, Latham tries to push but gets an inside edge. The ball misses the leg stump and goes to fine leg. Single taken and Latham is off the mark as well. Just two off the first over!
Landed around off, Latham prods forward and pushes it to the off side and shouts "No!"
Good length ball around off, Latham covers the line and defends.
UPPISH! Fullish outside off, Guptill drives it on the up towards mid off. The ball falls short of Axar Patel there. Single taken.
In the corridor outside off, Guptill leaves it alone.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, angling away, Guptill shoulders his arms.

The players are all set. There is an Indian team huddle. MS Dhoni gives some last minute tips. The Kiwi openers MARTIN GUPTILL and TOM LATHAM make their way to the middle. UMESH YADAV to bowl first up for India. Here we go!
The players are out for the national anthems. First it will be of New Zealand and then India.

Kane Williamson says he has messed it up again with the toss. Feels the surface is a good one to bat on. Adds they showed some improvement in the last game and thinks it's hard to say what's a good score on this wicket. Mentions they have just one change, Jimmy Neesham replaces Anton Devcich.

MS Dhoni (on how India have won another toss?) says the easiest answer is to flick it and wait for the opposition to call. Adds it's a good surface to bat on and has some amount of grass. He wants to give a few players some chance at some point of time in the series and they're playing with the same side today.
MS Dhoni spins the coins, and Kane Williamson calls it wrong.... Again! He's having no luck with this, is he? Another one in India's favour as they ELECT TO BOWL FIRST!

The Mohali wicket is a good one for batting and this is the perfect opportunity for Martin Guptill to fire away. The big Kiwi opener hasn't been doing too well lately, to say the least, and now's a good a time as any for him to return the faith shown in him by his skipper and selectors. The Black Caps will need him to start scoring if they are to give the Men in Blue another run for their money. Should be a good one, so stay tuned for the upcoming toss.

Hello and a warm welcome for the third match of this 5-match ODI series between India and New Zealand. The series is currently levelled 1-1 as the Kiwis managed to grab a narrow win in Delhi. This match holds a lot of significance as the one who wins here today will lead the series but more importantly, it will give the victor a psychological edge over the other. Doesn't look like there will be many or any changes in both teams today and if it's anything like last time, we can expect an entertaining contest.
